diff --git a/.github/workflows/target_one_batch_reconciliation.yml b/.github/workflows/target_one_batch_reconciliation.yml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..d790281
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/target_one_batch_reconciliation.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,120 @@
+name: Target one-batch reconciliation
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      confirmed_execution:
+        description: "Confirm one artifact-only target batch execution"
+        required: true
+        type: boolean
+        default: false
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: target-one-batch-reconciliation
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  reconcile:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 360
+    env:
+      TARGET_COMMIT: 8f4f6fa2459f4991eba95499cf69360045b10b27
+      BATCH_ID: historical-work-ids-0001
+      BATCH_PATH: seeds/reviewed/historical-work-ids-0001.txt
+      BATCH_SHA256: 59923176fa34796d7673a20b880af9abe5520fe484595edb220f2bbc0e3b33e7
+      BATCH_SIZE: "500"
+    steps:
+      - name: Check out donor batch
+        uses: actions/checkout@v6
+
+      - name: Check out exact target implementation
+        uses: actions/checkout@v6
+        with:
+          repository: edithatogo/archive-govt-nz
+          ref: ${{ env.TARGET_COMMIT }}
+          path: target
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Set up uv
+        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
+
+      - name: Set up Python
+        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
+        with:
+          python-version: "3.14"
+
+      - name: Validate authority, secret, target, and donor batch
+        env:
+          CONFIRMED_EXECUTION: ${{ inputs.confirmed_execution }}
+          LEGISLATION_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NZ_LEGISLATION_API_KEY }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test "$CONFIRMED_EXECUTION" = "true"
+          test -n "$LEGISLATION_API_KEY"
+          test "$(git -C target rev-parse HEAD)" = "$TARGET_COMMIT"
+          test "$(wc -l < "$BATCH_PATH" | tr -d ' ')" = "$BATCH_SIZE"
+          echo "$BATCH_SHA256  $BATCH_PATH" | sha256sum --check --strict
+
+      - name: Install exact target dependencies
+        working-directory: target
+        run: uv sync --frozen
+
+      - name: Execute one exact service-backed batch
+        id: harvest
+        working-directory: target
+        env:
+          LEGISLATION_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NZ_LEGISLATION_API_KEY }}
+        run: |
+          set +e
+          uv run --locked python tools/run_legislation_harvest.py \
+            --source-set-config config/source-sets/legislation.yml \
+            --checkpoint-path build/legislation-state/checkpoint.json \
+            --manifest-path build/legislation-state/manifest.json \
+            --cas-path build/legislation-state/cas \
+            --receipt-path build/legislation-state/receipts/harvest.json \
+            --batch-id "$BATCH_ID" \
+            --work-ids-file "../$BATCH_PATH" \
+            --max-works "$BATCH_SIZE"
+          code=$?
+          echo "exit_code=$code" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          exit 0
+
+      - name: Reconcile the explicit batch against target state
+        id: reconciliation
+        working-directory: target
+        run: |
+          set +e
+          uv run --locked python tools/reconcile_one_legislation_batch.py \
+            --batch-id "$BATCH_ID" \
+            --batch-path "../$BATCH_PATH" \
+            --expected-batch-sha256 "$BATCH_SHA256" \
+            --manifest-path build/legislation-state/manifest.json \
+            --checkpoint-path build/legislation-state/checkpoint.json \
+            --cas-path build/legislation-state/cas \
+            --receipt-path build/legislation-state/receipts/reconciliation.json
+          code=$?
+          echo "exit_code=$code" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          exit 0
+
+      - name: Upload bounded target state and receipts
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: target-legislation-one-batch-${{ github.run_id }}
+          path: |
+            target/build/legislation-state/
+            seeds/reviewed/historical-work-ids-0001.txt
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 90
+
+      - name: Enforce fail-closed outcome
+        env:
+          HARVEST_EXIT_CODE: ${{ steps.harvest.outputs.exit_code }}
+          RECONCILIATION_EXIT_CODE: ${{ steps.reconciliation.outputs.exit_code }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test "$HARVEST_EXIT_CODE" = "0"
+          test "$RECONCILIATION_EXIT_CODE" = "0"
diff --git a/tests/test_target_one_batch_bridge_workflow.py b/tests/test_target_one_batch_bridge_workflow.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ca34159
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_target_one_batch_bridge_workflow.py
@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+WORKFLOW = Path(".github/workflows/target_one_batch_reconciliation.yml")
+
+
+def test_target_one_batch_bridge_is_exact_and_artifact_only() -> None:
+    text = WORKFLOW.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert "8f4f6fa2459f4991eba95499cf69360045b10b27" in text
+    assert "59923176fa34796d7673a20b880af9abe5520fe484595edb220f2bbc0e3b33e7" in text
+    assert "--work-ids-file" in text
+    assert "working-directory: target" in text
+    assert "uv run --locked python tools/run_legislation_harvest.py" in text
+    assert '--work-ids-file "../$BATCH_PATH"' in text
+    assert "--expected-batch-sha256" in text
+    assert "LEGISLATION_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NZ_LEGISLATION_API_KEY }}" in text
+    assert "permissions:\n  contents: read" in text
+    assert "persist-credentials: false" in text
+    assert "actions/upload-artifact@v4" in text
+    assert "git push" not in text
+    assert "HF_TOKEN" not in text
+    assert "ZENODO" not in text
+
+
+def test_target_one_batch_bridge_preserves_failure_evidence() -> None:
+    text = WORKFLOW.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert "id: harvest" in text
+    assert "id: reconciliation" in text
+    assert "if: always()" in text
+    assert "HARVEST_EXIT_CODE" in text
+    assert "RECONCILIATION_EXIT_CODE" in text
+    assert text.index("Upload bounded target state and receipts") < text.index(
+        "Enforce fail-closed outcome"
+    )

@@ -0,0 +1,186 @@
+name: Target bounded live canary
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      confirmed_execution:
+        description: "Confirm one five-work live revalidation from proven state"
+        required: true
+        type: boolean
+        default: false
+
+permissions:
+  actions: read
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: target-bounded-live-canary
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  canary:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 90
+    env:
+      TARGET_COMMIT: d9abc05fa648f8b2049fb443477bc8f97691cf7f
+      PRIOR_RUN_ID: "32477973065"
+      PRIOR_ARTIFACT: target-legislation-one-batch-32477973065
+      PRIOR_MANIFEST_SHA256: a32dc371a1a47ae30a4afd58a9cbde2a439f3536d7705eb776e0fa68b4cd16db
+      PRIOR_INVENTORY_SHA256: 2abf0d8b76cc60e9b4e442724987b81848698dbdd98e56266f8726d468b33eaf
+      BATCH_ID: bounded-live-canary-0001
+      BATCH_PATH: seeds/reviewed/bounded-live-canary-0001.txt
+      BATCH_SHA256: ec71247b90e84d8c66f5d7fbd6283a9869abd647194feab22a4bc62510587743
+      BATCH_SIZE: "5"
+    steps:
+      - name: Check out donor canary scope
+        uses: actions/checkout@v6
+
+      - name: Check out exact target implementation
+        uses: actions/checkout@v6
+        with:
+          repository: edithatogo/archive-govt-nz
+          ref: ${{ env.TARGET_COMMIT }}
+          path: target
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Download proven one-batch state
+        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: ${{ env.PRIOR_ARTIFACT }}
+          path: prior-state
+          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
+          run-id: ${{ env.PRIOR_RUN_ID }}
+
+      - name: Set up uv
+        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
+
+      - name: Set up Python
+        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
+        with:
+          python-version: "3.14"
+
+      - name: Authenticate prior state and execution authority
+        env:
+          CONFIRMED_EXECUTION: ${{ inputs.confirmed_execution }}
+          LEGISLATION_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NZ_LEGISLATION_API_KEY }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test "$CONFIRMED_EXECUTION" = "true"
+          test -n "$LEGISLATION_API_KEY"
+          test "$(git -C target rev-parse HEAD)" = "$TARGET_COMMIT"
+          test "$(wc -l < "$BATCH_PATH" | tr -d ' ')" = "$BATCH_SIZE"
+          echo "$BATCH_SHA256  $BATCH_PATH" | sha256sum --check --strict
+          python - <<'PY'
+          import json
+          import os
+          from pathlib import Path
+
+          root = Path("prior-state/target/build/legislation-state")
+          manifest = json.loads((root / "manifest.json").read_text())
+          checkpoint = json.loads((root / "checkpoint.json").read_text())
+          harvest = json.loads((root / "receipts/harvest.json").read_text())
+          reconciliation = json.loads(
+              (root / "receipts/reconciliation.json").read_text()
+          )
+          assert manifest["manifest_sha256"] == os.environ["PRIOR_MANIFEST_SHA256"]
+          assert manifest["discovered_inventory_sha256"] == os.environ["PRIOR_INVENTORY_SHA256"]
+          assert manifest["total_records"] == 500
+          assert checkpoint["metadata"]["manifest_sha256"] == os.environ["PRIOR_MANIFEST_SHA256"]
+          assert checkpoint["metadata"]["discovered_inventory_sha256"] == os.environ["PRIOR_INVENTORY_SHA256"]
+          assert checkpoint["total_records_preserved"] == 500
+          assert harvest["outcome"] == "changed" and harvest["state_committed"] is True
+          assert reconciliation["status"] == "passed"
+          assert reconciliation["mismatch_count"] == 0
+          PY
+          mkdir -p target/build
+          cp -R prior-state/target/build/legislation-state target/build/
+
+      - name: Install exact target dependencies
+        working-directory: target
+        run: uv sync --frozen
+
+      - name: Revalidate five exact works against the live service
+        id: harvest
+        working-directory: target
+        env:
+          LEGISLATION_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NZ_LEGISLATION_API_KEY }}
+        run: |
+          set +e
+          uv run --locked python tools/run_legislation_harvest.py \
+            --source-set-config config/source-sets/legislation.yml \
+            --checkpoint-path build/legislation-state/checkpoint.json \
+            --manifest-path build/legislation-state/manifest.json \
+            --cas-path build/legislation-state/cas \
+            --receipt-path build/legislation-state/receipts/canary-harvest.json \
+            --batch-id "$BATCH_ID" \
+            --work-ids-file "../$BATCH_PATH" \
+            --max-works "$BATCH_SIZE" \
+            --force-resync
+          code=$?
+          echo "exit_code=$code" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          exit 0
+
+      - name: Reconcile canary identities and cumulative state
+        id: reconciliation
+        working-directory: target
+        run: |
+          set +e
+          uv run --locked python tools/reconcile_one_legislation_batch.py \
+            --batch-id "$BATCH_ID" \
+            --batch-path "../$BATCH_PATH" \
+            --expected-batch-sha256 "$BATCH_SHA256" \
+            --manifest-path build/legislation-state/manifest.json \
+            --checkpoint-path build/legislation-state/checkpoint.json \
+            --cas-path build/legislation-state/cas \
+            --receipt-path build/legislation-state/receipts/canary-reconciliation.json
+          code=$?
+          echo "exit_code=$code" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          exit 0
+
+      - name: Validate live canary receipts
+        id: receipt_validation
+        working-directory: target
+        run: |
+          set +e
+          uv run --locked python - <<'PY'
+          import json
+          from pathlib import Path
+
+          root = Path("build/legislation-state/receipts")
+          harvest = json.loads((root / "canary-harvest.json").read_text())
+          reconciliation = json.loads((root / "canary-reconciliation.json").read_text())
+          assert harvest["force_resync"] is True
+          assert harvest["works_attempted"] == 5
+          assert harvest["outcome"] in {"changed", "no_change"}
+          assert harvest["state_committed"] is True
+          assert harvest["errors"] == []
+          assert reconciliation["status"] == "passed"
+          assert reconciliation["mismatch_count"] == 0
+          assert reconciliation["batch_work_ids_count"] == 5
+          assert reconciliation["manifest_total_records"] >= 500
+          PY
+          code=$?
+          echo "exit_code=$code" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          exit 0
+
+      - name: Upload cumulative canary state and receipts
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: target-legislation-live-canary-${{ github.run_id }}
+          path: |
+            target/build/legislation-state/
+            seeds/reviewed/bounded-live-canary-0001.txt
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 90
+
+      - name: Enforce fail-closed canary outcome
+        env:
+          HARVEST_EXIT_CODE: ${{ steps.harvest.outputs.exit_code }}
+          RECONCILIATION_EXIT_CODE: ${{ steps.reconciliation.outputs.exit_code }}
+          RECEIPT_VALIDATION_EXIT_CODE: ${{ steps.receipt_validation.outputs.exit_code }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test "$HARVEST_EXIT_CODE" = "0"
+          test "$RECONCILIATION_EXIT_CODE" = "0"
+          test "$RECEIPT_VALIDATION_EXIT_CODE" = "0"

+name: Target weekly legislation cycle
+
+on:
+  schedule:
+    - cron: "17 16 * * 0"
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      confirmed_execution:
+        description: "Confirm one manual full-inventory weekly cycle"
+        required: true
+        type: boolean
+        default: false
+
+permissions:
+  actions: read
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: target-weekly-legislation-cycle
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  weekly-cycle:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 180
+    env:
+      TARGET_COMMIT: d9abc05fa648f8b2049fb443477bc8f97691cf7f
+      BOOTSTRAP_RUN_ID: "32487223314"
+      BOOTSTRAP_ARTIFACT: target-legislation-live-canary-32487223314
+      BATCH_PATH: seeds/reviewed/historical-work-ids-0001.txt
+      BATCH_SHA256: 59923176fa34796d7673a20b880af9abe5520fe484595edb220f2bbc0e3b33e7
+      BATCH_SIZE: "500"
+    steps:
+      - name: Check out donor inventory
+        uses: actions/checkout@v6
+
+      - name: Check out exact target implementation
+        uses: actions/checkout@v6
+        with:
+          repository: edithatogo/archive-govt-nz
+          ref: ${{ env.TARGET_COMMIT }}
+          path: target
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Select and download latest verified continuation state
+        id: prior_state
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          if [ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
+            test "${{ inputs.confirmed_execution }}" = "true"
+          fi
+          prior_run_id=$(gh run list \
+            --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
+            --workflow target_weekly_legislation_cycle.yml \
+            --status success \
+            --limit 1 \
+            --json databaseId \
+            --jq '.[0].databaseId // empty')
+          if [ -n "$prior_run_id" ]; then
+            prior_artifact="target-legislation-weekly-$prior_run_id"
+          else
+            prior_run_id="$BOOTSTRAP_RUN_ID"
+            prior_artifact="$BOOTSTRAP_ARTIFACT"
+          fi
+          case "$prior_run_id" in (*[!0-9]*|'') exit 2;; esac
+          gh run download "$prior_run_id" \
+            --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
+            --name "$prior_artifact" \
+            --dir prior-state
+          echo "run_id=$prior_run_id" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "artifact=$prior_artifact" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+      - name: Set up uv
+        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
+
+      - name: Set up Python
+        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
+        with:
+          python-version: "3.14"
+
+      - name: Validate execution inputs and restore cumulative state
+        env:
+          LEGISLATION_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NZ_LEGISLATION_API_KEY }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test -n "$LEGISLATION_API_KEY"
+          test "$(git -C target rev-parse HEAD)" = "$TARGET_COMMIT"
+          test "$(wc -l < "$BATCH_PATH" | tr -d ' ')" = "$BATCH_SIZE"
+          echo "$BATCH_SHA256  $BATCH_PATH" | sha256sum --check --strict
+          test -f prior-state/target/build/legislation-state/manifest.json
+          test -f prior-state/target/build/legislation-state/checkpoint.json
+          test -d prior-state/target/build/legislation-state/cas/sha256
+          mkdir -p target/build
+          cp -R prior-state/target/build/legislation-state target/build/
+
+      - name: Install exact target dependencies
+        working-directory: target
+        run: uv sync --frozen
+
+      - name: Verify every incoming CAS object
+        working-directory: target
+        run: |
+          uv run --locked python tools/verify_object_store.py \
+            --root build/legislation-state/cas \
+            --output build/legislation-state/receipts/incoming-cas-verification.json
+          uv run --locked python - <<'PY'
+          import json
+          from pathlib import Path
+
+          receipt = json.loads(
+              Path("build/legislation-state/receipts/incoming-cas-verification.json").read_text()
+          )
+          assert receipt["object_count"] >= 500
+          assert receipt["verified"] == receipt["object_count"]
+          assert receipt["failed"] == 0
+          PY
+
+      - name: Revalidate complete reviewed inventory against live service
+        id: harvest
+        working-directory: target
+        env:
+          LEGISLATION_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NZ_LEGISLATION_API_KEY }}
+          BATCH_ID: weekly-${{ github.run_id }}
+        run: |
+          set +e
+          uv run --locked python tools/run_legislation_harvest.py \
+            --source-set-config config/source-sets/legislation.yml \
+            --checkpoint-path build/legislation-state/checkpoint.json \
+            --manifest-path build/legislation-state/manifest.json \
+            --cas-path build/legislation-state/cas \
+            --receipt-path build/legislation-state/receipts/weekly-harvest.json \
+            --batch-id "$BATCH_ID" \
+            --work-ids-file "../$BATCH_PATH" \
+            --max-works "$BATCH_SIZE" \
+            --force-resync
+          code=$?
+          echo "exit_code=$code" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          exit 0
+
+      - name: Reconcile weekly identities and cumulative state
+        id: reconciliation
+        working-directory: target
+        env:
+          BATCH_ID: weekly-${{ github.run_id }}
+        run: |
+          set +e
+          uv run --locked python tools/reconcile_one_legislation_batch.py \
+            --batch-id "$BATCH_ID" \
+            --batch-path "../$BATCH_PATH" \
+            --expected-batch-sha256 "$BATCH_SHA256" \
+            --manifest-path build/legislation-state/manifest.json \
+            --checkpoint-path build/legislation-state/checkpoint.json \
+            --cas-path build/legislation-state/cas \
+            --receipt-path build/legislation-state/receipts/weekly-reconciliation.json
+          code=$?
+          echo "exit_code=$code" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          exit 0
+
+      - name: Validate weekly receipts
+        id: receipt_validation
+        working-directory: target
+        env:
+          PRIOR_STATE_RUN_ID: ${{ steps.prior_state.outputs.run_id }}
+          PRIOR_STATE_ARTIFACT: ${{ steps.prior_state.outputs.artifact }}
+        run: |
+          set +e
+          uv run --locked python - <<'PY'
+          import json
+          import os
+          from pathlib import Path
+
+          root = Path("build/legislation-state/receipts")
+          harvest = json.loads((root / "weekly-harvest.json").read_text())
+          reconciliation = json.loads((root / "weekly-reconciliation.json").read_text())
+          assert harvest["force_resync"] is True
+          assert harvest["works_attempted"] == 500
+          assert harvest["outcome"] in {"changed", "no_change"}
+          assert harvest["state_committed"] is True
+          assert harvest["errors"] == []
+          assert reconciliation["status"] == "passed"
+          assert reconciliation["mismatch_count"] == 0
+          assert reconciliation["batch_work_ids_count"] == 500
+          assert reconciliation["manifest_total_records"] >= 500
+          lineage = {
+              "schema_version": "corpus-legislation-nz.weekly-state-lineage/v1",
+              "prior_run_id": int(os.environ["PRIOR_STATE_RUN_ID"]),
+              "prior_artifact": os.environ["PRIOR_STATE_ARTIFACT"],
+              "manifest_sha256": harvest["manifest_sha256"],
+              "discovered_works_count": harvest["discovered_works_count"],
+          }
+          (root / "weekly-state-lineage.json").write_text(
+              json.dumps(lineage, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
+          )
+          PY
+          code=$?
+          echo "exit_code=$code" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          exit 0
+
+      - name: Upload cumulative weekly state and receipts
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: target-legislation-weekly-${{ github.run_id }}
+          path: |
+            target/build/legislation-state/
+            seeds/reviewed/historical-work-ids-0001.txt
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 90
+
+      - name: Enforce fail-closed weekly outcome
+        env:
+          HARVEST_EXIT_CODE: ${{ steps.harvest.outputs.exit_code }}
+          RECONCILIATION_EXIT_CODE: ${{ steps.reconciliation.outputs.exit_code }}
+          RECEIPT_VALIDATION_EXIT_CODE: ${{ steps.receipt_validation.outputs.exit_code }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test "$HARVEST_EXIT_CODE" = "0"
+          test "$RECONCILIATION_EXIT_CODE" = "0"
+          test "$RECEIPT_VALIDATION_EXIT_CODE" = "0"

--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_target_weekly_legislation_cycle_workflow.py
@@ -0,0 +1,42 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+WORKFLOW = Path(".github/workflows/target_weekly_legislation_cycle.yml")
+
+
+def test_weekly_cycle_is_scheduled_pinned_and_full_inventory() -> None:
+    text = WORKFLOW.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert 'cron: "17 16 * * 0"' in text
+    assert "workflow_dispatch:" in text
+    assert "d9abc05fa648f8b2049fb443477bc8f97691cf7f" in text
+    assert 'BOOTSTRAP_RUN_ID: "32487223314"' in text
+    assert "59923176fa34796d7673a20b880af9abe5520fe484595edb220f2bbc0e3b33e7" in text
+    assert 'BATCH_SIZE: "500"' in text
+    assert "--force-resync" in text
+    assert 'harvest["works_attempted"] == 500' in text
+
+
+def test_weekly_cycle_chains_and_verifies_complete_state() -> None:
+    text = WORKFLOW.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert "--workflow target_weekly_legislation_cycle.yml" in text
+    assert "--status success" in text
+    assert 'prior_artifact="target-legislation-weekly-$prior_run_id"' in text
+    assert "tools/verify_object_store.py" in text
+    assert 'receipt["verified"] == receipt["object_count"]' in text
+    assert "weekly-state-lineage.json" in text
+    assert "target-legislation-weekly-${{ github.run_id }}" in text
+
+
+def test_weekly_cycle_remains_fail_closed_and_non_publicating() -> None:
+    text = WORKFLOW.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert "actions: read\n  contents: read" in text
+    assert "persist-credentials: false" in text
+    assert "LEGISLATION_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NZ_LEGISLATION_API_KEY }}" in text
+    assert "if: always()" in text
+    assert "HARVEST_EXIT_CODE" in text
+    assert "RECONCILIATION_EXIT_CODE" in text
+    assert "RECEIPT_VALIDATION_EXIT_CODE" in text
+    assert "git push" not in text
+    assert "HF_TOKEN" not in text
+    assert "ZENODO" not in text
